items.title: 2.8.1.1 Defining Classes and Creating Objects (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of defining classes (PDF 57-58).

blocks.text: Programming mein class ko ek concept (khayal) ki tarah istemal kar ke tay kiya jata hai ke object kaisa hoga.

# Define a class called ToyCar
class ToyCar:
    # The __init__ method in idealizes the object with specific attributes
    def __init__(self , color, size , wheels) :
        self.color = color # Color of the toy car
        self.size = size    # Size of the toy car
        self.wheels = wheels # Number of wheels in toy car
    # Method to describe the
    def describe(self) :
        return "This toy car is" , self.color , "size", self.size, "and has " , self.wheels , "Wheels."
# Create objects of the ToyCar class
car1 = ToyCar("red", "small", 4)
car2 = ToyCar("blue", "large", 6)
# Print descriptions of the
print(car1.describe( ))
print(car2.describe( ))

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke code mein teen ghaltiyan hain: (1) __init__ ke brackets mein faltu "self.color = color" chhapa hai; sahi def __init__(self, color, size, wheels): hai. (2) "large” tirchhi quote par khatam hota hai, is liye string band nahi hoti; sahi "large". (3) print(carl.describe()) mein carl (chhota L) hai, jabke object car1 (ek) hai; NameError aata hai. Wazahat mein bhi "carl" chhapa hai.

('This toy car is', 'red', 'size', 'small', 'and has ', 4, 'Wheels.')

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: describe() mein return ke baad values comma se alag hain, is liye Python ek tuple wapas karti hai aur output brackets aur quotes ke saath aata hai, jaise oopar. Ek saaf sentence chahiye ho to f-string istemal karein: return f"This toy car is {self.color}, size {self.size} and has {self.wheels} wheels."

Class definition: ToyCar class khilona gaariyan banane ka saancha hai. Yeh batati hai ke har gaari ke attributes (khoobiyan) kya hain: color, size aur wheels. __init__ method object bante waqt yeh values set karta hai (initialize karta hai; kitab ke comment mein "idealizes" chhapa hai).
Objects banana: car1 aur car2 ToyCar saanche se bani do khaas gaariyan hain; har ek ki apni values hain (laal, chhoti, 4 pahiye; neeli, bari, 6 pahiye).
Methods istemal karna: describe method gaari ki description (bayan) deta hai.
self: self OOP ka ek convention (aam tareeqa) hai: method ke andar self se class ka woh khaas object (instance) murad hai jis par method chal raha hai.
